title: Practice 16: The present tense: the Е and И types

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: Nesting on the island is a small population of penguins.
exercises.why: **гнездиться → гнездится** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: They don't worship idols.
exercises.why: **поклоняться → поклоняются** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: It's too flashy.
exercises.why: **бросаться → бросается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: What's life like for the people of Gaza?
exercises.why: **житься → живётся** — present tense,  person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: The old man is pruning his rose bushes.
exercises.why: **подрезать → подрезает** — present-type form, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I seldom walk anywhere.
exercises.why: **ходить → хожу** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.q: Твоё полупрозрачное платье очень сильно ___ (возбуждать) меня.
exercises.prompt: I am completely agog over your diaphanous dress.
exercises.why: **возбуждать → возбуждает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: У неё в одно ухо ___ (влетать), в другое вылетает.
exercises.prompt: With her, it goes in one ear and out the other.
exercises.why: **влетать → влетает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Cherries are ripe in June or July.
exercises.why: **созревать → созревает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Television stultifies people.
exercises.why: **отуплять → отупляет** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: In what language is the word "war" more terrible?
exercises.why: **ужасать → ужасает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Tom is getting ready for school.
exercises.why: **готовиться → готовится** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Why do we have dreams?
exercises.why: **сниться → снятся** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ят belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: The contents of the four registers are preserved by the called subroutine.
exercises.why: **сохраняться → сохраняется** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: The winter solstice is approaching.
exercises.why: **приближаться → Приближается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I think you're lying.
exercises.why: **лгать → лжете** — present tense, 2nd person plural: ending -ете belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: He opposes racism.
exercises.why: **выступать → выступает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Tom is moody at times.
exercises.why: **капризничать → капризничает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Tom limps slightly.
exercises.why: **прихрамывать → прихрамывает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: It looks like Tom is winning.
exercises.why: **побеждать → побеждает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
